{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "PK and immunogenicity endpoints lack pre-planned statistical analyses",
      "quote": "To assess the PK of T-DXd, total anti-HER2 antibody and MAAA-1181a in serum.",
      "page": 37,
      "section": "3 Objectives and Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The PK and ADA endpoints are listed in the objectives/endpoints table but no corresponding analysis is described in the statistical analysis section (Table 17).",
      "fix": "Add pre-planned statistical analyses for PK parameters and ADA incidence/titers in Section 9.4."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint is confirmed ORR assessed by ICR per RECIST v1.1 across all tumor types.",
      "page": 94,
      "section": "9.4.2.2 Primary Endpoint(s)",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The estimand for the primary endpoint is incomplete: no explicit population (FAS vs MDAS vs CEAS), no intercurrent event strategy (e.g., how to handle death, subsequent therapy, or missing data), and no summary measure beyond proportion.",
      "fix": "Define the estimand attributes (population, variable, intercurrent events, summary measure) for the primary endpoint."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing sample size justification",
      "quote": "sample_size: null",
      "page": 90,
      "section": "9 Statistical Considerations",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not provide a sample size calculation or justification, which is essential for trial planning and power.",
      "fix": "Add a sample size section with assumptions (alpha, power, effect size, dropout) and rationale."
    },
    {
      "title": "No analysis specified for proportion alive and progression-free at 6 and 12 months",
      "quote": "Proportion of patients alive and progression-free at 6 and 12 months.",
      "page": 37,
      "section": "3 Objectives and Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The endpoint is listed but the statistical analysis table (Table 17) only mentions PFS and OS; no explicit analysis for the proportion alive and progression-free at 6 and 12 months is described.",
      "fix": "Add a pre-planned analysis for the proportion alive and progression-free at 6 and 12 months (e.g., Kaplan-Meier estimates)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing handling of missing data",
      "quote": "procedures for accounting for missing, unused, and spurious data.",
      "page": 92,
      "section": "9.4 Statistical Analyses",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol defers missing data handling to the SAP but does not specify any methods in the protocol, which is a gap for regulatory review.",
      "fix": "Describe the primary approach for handling missing data (e.g., censoring rules, sensitivity analyses) in the protocol."
    },
    {
      "title": "No multiplicity control for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "Secondary efficacy endpoints include confirmed ORR by Investigator assessment per REC",
      "page": 94,
      "section": "9.4.2.3 Secondary Endpoint(s)",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Multiple secondary endpoints are listed but no adjustment for multiplicity is described, which could inflate type I error.",
      "fix": "Specify a multiplicity control strategy (e.g., hierarchical testing, Bonferroni) for secondary endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent analysis population for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "The FAS will be used for all efficacy analyses.",
      "page": 91,
      "section": "9.3 Populations for Analyses",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The FAS is stated to be used for all efficacy analyses, but the primary endpoint analysis does not explicitly state the population, and the CEAS may be used for sensitivity analyses, creating ambiguity.",
      "fix": "Explicitly state the primary analysis population (FAS) for the primary endpoint and clarify the role of CEAS."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size inputs missing or inconsistent",
      "quote": "sample_size: null",
      "page": 90,
      "section": "9 Statistical Considerations",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "No sample size is provided, and no alpha, power, or effect size are stated, making it impossible to assess trial feasibility.",
      "fix": "Include a complete sample size justification with all inputs."
    }
  ]
}
